name: My Trusty Arbalest cheapens Witchbane and Shadowblast and adds hit (#1897)
contract: My Trusty Arbalest 503682 (rank 1) and 504892 (rank 2) are SpellFamily 21, passive (Attributes 0x1c0). Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), BasePoints -11 / -21 with DieSides 1 = -10 / -20 percent, EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 0x400000 (Witchbane 800165) and word 2 = 0x10 (Shadowblast 804191); both targets cost 400 Rage (stored x10) and SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_COST) (SpellInfo.cpp:3074), so 400 becomes 360 / 320. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT (333), BasePoints 1 / 3 + 1 = 2 / 4 percent, which HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll routes to both the melee and the spell hit fields (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4845, StatSystem.cpp:999-1011). The scenario reads Player::m_modMeleeHitChance and m_modSpellHitChance through melee_hit_chance and spell_hit_chance. Dawn Blade (Rage 300, outside both masks) is the control.
